newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANZ cuts Money Saver mortgage rate.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANZ cuts Money Saver mortgage rate.

text.p: One of Australia's four major private banks, Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd, said on Monday it would reduce the interest rate on its Money Saver Home Loan mortgage product.
ANZ said the rate will be cut to 6.95 percent from 7.29 percent for new loans on February 6. Existing customers will receive the new rate on March 3.
The Money Saver loan is available only for owner-occupier loans with a minimum loan of A$50,000.
The standard variable rate of the major banks is set at about 8.25 percent. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
